fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./tools/release/... -run TestCut with a fake git tags and pushes once when every gate passes, never for a major, never twice for one version and never when a gate fails; release.yml uses the tag annotation as the notes; the timer unit is in the repo and the VM runbook names it
fields.statement: A systemd user timer on the VM runs tools/release hourly in the root main checkout; when check passes for a minor or patch it pushes an annotated tag carrying the notes, and the release job publishes them as the release body

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./tools/release/... -run TestMajor holds a major until the sign-off is given and then cuts it once
fields.statement: A major candidate is never tagged by the tool: it waits for the owner sign-off, then tags and pushes as for a minor

Release tooling is for this repo only, so a major release cannot raise a Rhiza inbox item: how does the owner see and sign off a major candidate (e.g. a draft GitHub release the owner publishes, a rhiza request, or a hand-pushed tag)?
